name: Soldsteps Theme Widgets with Elementor
author: Ashraf Ali

sections.description:
Soldsteps Theme Widgets with Elementor adds useful and customizable widgets to enhance your website design.

This plugin is built with performance, security, and flexibility in mind.

Features

  • Custom Slider Widget
  • Team Member Widget
  • Services Widget
  • Counter Widget
  • Fully responsive design
  • Easy to use with Elementor
  • Clean and optimized code
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/soldsteps-theme-widgets-elementor directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Start using widgets from the Elementor editor.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes, you must install and activate Elementor before using this plugin.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, this plugin is completely free and open source.

Can I customize the widgets?

Yes, all widgets come with customizable options inside Elementor.

short_description: A lightweight Elementor addon plugin that provides custom widgets like Slider, Team, Services, and Counter.
